pressure_packet.title: Pass the supper parcel to Felix
pressure_packet.situation: Clara has the household supper parcel that Felix requested before his field shift.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Transfer one supper parcel from Clara's carried stock to Felix.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The household pantry note assigns Clara one supper parcel for Felix.
Clara carries exactly one supper parcel.
Felix is the named household recipient and his actor container is current.

active_goals.description: Transfer one supper parcel from Clara's carried stock to Felix.

pressure_packet.title: Gather the courier herb measure
pressure_packet.situation: The clinic courier kit lacks its herb measure, and Kara is assigned to collect it from the public herb garden.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Gather one herb for the clinic courier kit.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The courier ledger binds Kara to supply one herb before the clinic cart leaves.
The public herb garden has four herb units remaining.
Kara has herbalism capability level one; this operation needs no carried tool.

active_goals.description: Gather one herb for the clinic courier kit.

pressure_packet.title: Commission a replacement pickaxe
pressure_packet.situation: Dorian has the iron, timber, and service fee for a smith-made replacement pickaxe.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Commission one replacement pickaxe from Bram.

actor_visible_facts.statement: Dorian holds the current smith service card naming Bram as provider.
Dorian carries one iron ore, one timber, and three coin.
The service consumes both materials plus two coin and returns one pickaxe.

active_goals.description: Commission one replacement pickaxe from Bram.

pressure_packet.title: Prepare the carrier-night noodles
pressure_packet.situation: Elin is responsible for the carrier-night meal, but has neither cooking skill nor flour for the only registered noodle recipe.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Prepare one serving of noodles for the night carriers.

actor_visible_facts.statement: The carrier roster assigns tonight's noodle serving to Elin.
Elin carries no flour and has no cooking capability.
The closed catalogue contains only the registered noodle recipe, which requires one flour and cooking capability level one.

active_goals.description: Prepare one serving of noodles for the night carriers.

pressure_packet.title: Gather the orchard market sample
pressure_packet.situation: The orchard's east row has ripe fruit, and Aiko is carrying the basket used for the market sample.
pressure_packet.immediate_objective: Gather one fruit from the east row for the market sample.

actor_visible_facts.statement: Aiko holds the sampling note for the east orchard row.
The row has four fruit units and Aiko has gather capability level one.
Aiko carries and equips the basket required by the row operation.

active_goals.description: Gather one fruit from the east row for the market sample.

Grace carries one seasoned timber and four coin.
